title: Do LLMs Really Lack Difference Awareness? Uncovering Heuristic Substitution in Group-Differentiating Fairness
abstract: arXiv:2610.26961v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we investigate the issue of difference awareness in LLMs, defined as a model's ability to recognize and acknowledge meaningful differences between social groups in fairness decision-making. Previous studies have consistently shown that models perform poorly on such tasks, a finding commonly attributed to a lack of difference awareness. We propose an alternative account, which we term Fairness Heuristic Substitution: difference awareness is not necessarily absent, but the complex demand of simultaneously identifying relevant group differences and determining their implications for fairness decisions may lead models to substitute the simpler, more accessible equal-treatment heuristic, i.e., formal equality. translated_title: 大语言模型真的缺乏差异意识吗？揭示群体差异化公平中的启发式替代现象
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们研究了大语言模型（LLMs）中的差异意识问题，即模型在公平性决策中识别和承认社会群体间有意义差异的能力。以往的研究一致表明，模型在这类任务上表现不佳，这一发现通常被归因于模型缺乏差异意识。我们提出了一种替代性解释，称之为公平启发式替代：差异意识并非必然缺失，而是同时识别相关群体差异并确定其对公平决策影响这一复杂需求，可能导致模型转而采用更简单、更易获取的平等待遇启发式（即形式平等）。基于这一假设，我们引入了TDD——一个两阶段“区分-决策”框架，将公平性推理明确分解为两个步骤：首先区分情境中相关的群体差异，然后做出相应的公平决策。
tldr: 本文提出大语言模型在群体差异化公平任务中的失败并非源于缺乏差异意识，而是因为“公平启发式替代”——模型用更简单的形式平等启发式替代了复杂的差异识别与权衡过程，并据此提出两阶段“区分-决策”框架TDD来改善这一问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes that LLMs' poor performance in group-differentiating fairness stems not from a genuine lack of difference awareness, but from "Fairness Heuristic Substitution"—models default to the simpler equal-treatment heuristic—and introduces TDD, a Two-stage Distinguish-Decide framework to address this issue.
